name: jurypersona
description: Run a persona jury as an engine: personas, panels, lenses, evidence on every line, scores per stratum. No LLM inside the engine. Needs the jurypersona binary on PATH.

interface.shortDescription: A persona jury as an engine: evidence on every line, scores per stratum
interface.longDescription: Use JuryPersona to judge a page, diff, design or document with personas that your own agent runs: write the briefs, ingest the verdicts, refuse any verdict without evidence, and read the scores per stratum, never averaged.
defaultPrompt: Run a jury on this page with three personas.
Help me write personas from this customer document.
